sources.data_semantics: Derived historical evidence containing per-tract counts of reported incidents. It is not live, complete, an official City publication, a victim probability, absolute safety, or a safest-route signal; modeled exposure is reserved for explicitly modeled downstream calculations.

license.label: Derived artifact; upstream City terms apply

retrieval.mode: completion of validated build-time upstream aggregate retrieval
retrieval.meaning: When all upstream tract aggregate responses completed; not the latest incident date, artifact build time, runtime observation, completeness, or authority.

build.mode: deterministic per-tract aggregation and validated snapshot/receipt publication
build.meaning: When the validated snapshot candidate was built; not sourceAsOf, retrieval completion, or runtime observation.

fail_closed.reason: Missing or invalid snapshot/receipt evidence is unavailable, never an observed zero or current source.
